ZWE.note: The programme targets persons with disabilities and marginalised youth; no rural connectivity programme or rural/urban use split is stated.
No national digital strategy is mentioned.

facts.fact: Potraz, the regulator, launched a programme to address digital exclusion among persons with disabilities, now in its second year, following a nationwide survey; Executive Director Kennedy Dewere cited training and hardware provision.

ZWE.note: No number of people reached or devices delivered is stated, so no delivered fact.
Potraz is the regulator, not a local think tank or university; its survey is not placed as local research institution output.
